svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A bug in decide: debug crashes with the history, release logs it and the screen lives
svg.desc: The like capability throws in decide on LikeClicked. In a debug build Capsa.failFast is true: Capsa throws CapsaViolationException, whose message lists the violation and the last events of the runtime, and the app crashes. In a release build Capsa.failFast is false: Capsa hands the error to CapsaLogger, which can send it to a crash reporter, and the screen keeps its last valid slice and goes on with the next facts.
